newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Inkombank to sign $115 mln loan deal Aug 7.
newsitem.headline: Russian Inkombank to sign $115 mln loan deal Aug 7.

text.p: Russia's fourth biggest bank by assets, Inkombank, and a 36-member group of Western banks, led by Deutsche Bank AG and NatWest Markets will sign a $115 million loan deal on August 7, Inkombank said on Tuesday.
The unguaranteed credit will be granted for 12 months with a possibility of extension at LIBOR plus 4.25 percent, Inkombank said in a statement.
Within the last year Inkombank has raised a total of $187 million in international credits, a spokesman said.
